label: sec:substrate-from-leptons-intro
html: We calibrate the substrate parameter q using lepton masses alone. The q-deformed Skein relation encodes the deformation of the standard Skein identity. Knot volume verification (SnapPy) independently checks hyperbolic volumes. A classification of building-block knots provides Jones polynomials and volumes required for mass formulas. This outputs the calibrated value q_0 \approx 1.1100. The subsequent section applies this to the full hadron spectrum.
